# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-low

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

A "saturation" run: one agent implements both features on the 50-pair `flash` subset with a budget large enough that steps should not be what limits it. Setup: `gemini-3.8-flash` at `low` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 64K, the per-turn step counter, and a `$40` per-agent cost cap. It tells us which tasks `solo` can and cannot solve at this thinking level when budget is not the constraint, so later `coop` failures on solvable tasks can be read as coordination failures. It ran as two 25-pair halves on two API keys and was merged into this one run.

## Observations

- 36/50 (72%) for `$25.70`. Budget was not the limit: no agent came near 500 steps (the longest used 345), every agent submitted, and the median agent finished in 84 steps. At `low` thinking the context rarely reached 64K, so most agents never compacted.
- All 14 failures are wrong answers, not unfinished ones. The agent submitted and believed it was done, but at least one feature failed its hidden tests (in 12 of the 14, one feature passed and the other failed). These look like capability or understanding failures at this thinking level.
- Of the 36 passes, 22 needed at most 100 steps and 35 at most 250. So for this model at `low`, 250 steps with the counter would have lost only one pass.
- Failing pairs: `dspy_task/8394` (3,5), `go_chi_task/56` (1,5), `huggingface_datasets_task/3997` (2,4), `llama_index_task/18813` (1,5) and (2,5), `openai_tiktoken_task/0` (2,9), `pallets_click_task/2068` (2,10), `pallets_click_task/2800` (1,3), `pillow_task/25` (1,5), `pillow_task/290` (2,3) and (4,5), `pillow_task/68` (1,5), `samuelcolvin_dirty_equals_task/43` (2,3) and (3,7).
- 1,037 calls were retried because of the API rate limit with 3 agents per key; that only slows `solo` agents down (see the concurrency table in [model_config.md](../../notes/model_config.md)).
